title: Playboy 1990 Sharon Stone Margaux Hemingway Girls of ACC Lot of 4 + 1 Bonus
descriptionText:
Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from 1990 featuring notable celebrity covers, pictorials, interviews and classic Playboy content.

Included in this lot:

April 1990 – Girls of the A.C.C. issue featuring Allegra Curtis, daughter of Tony Curtis, along with the Girls of the ACC pictorial.

May 1990 – Margaux Hemingway cover and pictorial featuring an interview with Dave Barry, profile of John Malkovich, Jennifer Tilly feature, 1990 baseball coverage and Playboy’s music poll results.

July 1990 – Sharon Stone cover and pictorial. Also includes an interview with music legend Quincy Jones by Alex Haley, Aaron Neville feature and Jacqueline Sheen as Playmate of the Month. This is one of the more collectible 1990 Playboy issues due to the Sharon Stone cover. 

October 1990 – Girls of the Big West issue featuring college-themed pictorial content, college football coverage and Buster Douglas.

All four magazines are original vintage issues and are being sold together as one lot. They are pre-owned and show normal signs of age, storage and handling, including possible light cover wear, edge wear, surface marks and corner wear. Overall they present well for their age based on the photos.

Please review all photos carefully for exact cosmetic condition. You will receive the four magazines pictured.

Great addition to a Playboy collection, vintage magazine collection, celebrity collection, or 1990s pop-culture collection.
